summary: Bending Spoons S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of its all-cash acquisition of 100% of Formagrid Inc. (d/b/a Airtable), a Delaware corporation, effective September 4, 2026. No price per share, total consideration, premium, or break fee was disclosed. The deal marks Bending Spoons' first acquisition since its Nasdaq listing on July 1, 2026. Bending Spoons expects to include Airtable in its financial outlook at next results. Advisors: Willkie Farr & Gallagher and EY Advisory for Bending Spoons; Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan as co-financial advisors; Latham & Watkins and AXOM Partners for Airtable. Watch for integration updates and future earnings guidance revisions.
